Translators, directors, sound engineers who work subtly and sensitively with the material. We welcome actors and announcers who can be heard daily in the cinema, on television, on the radio, in films, in advertising and in various shows.

services.title: Services
services.intro: If you need localization of a movie trailer, film, series or creating an advertising audio clip, we will be happy to help. What can we offer?

voiceover.title: VOICEOVER
voiceover.description: video voice-over. When the original sound is heard and the translation is on top in 1, 2, 4, 6 or more voices. The most budget-friendly, fast and popular type of sound work.

dubvoice.title: DUB+VOICEOVER
dubvoice.description: something between regular voice-over and dubbing. Among professionals, this type got nicknames 'dub-voice', 'voice-dub' or 'lazy' dubbing. Phrases are 90%+ lip-sync, i.e. synchronous with the character on screen. The original voice is either not heard at all, or very far away. In fact, this is dubbing, but with a less careful approach to intonation, acting, sound effects and minimal sound design.

dubbing.title: DUBBING
dubbing.description: full multi-voice dubbing. The kind we are used to hearing in the cinema. Dolby Digital 5.1

dcp.title: DCP
dcp.description: video rendering into a digital cinema package for playback in cinemas.

advertising.title: ADVERTISING
advertising.description: from creating advertising text to a finished mixed soundtrack.

complex.title: COMPLEX TEXTS
complex.description: medical, chemical, legal, historical and other specialized topics.

additional.title: ADDITIONAL SERVICES
